title: Diphthongs and complex vowels
keyIdea: Some vowel sounds are spelt with two letters, and some letter pairs can say more than one sound. ow says the sound in cow and also the sound in snow, so a reader tries both and picks the real word. Some sounds have two spellings: ou and ow (cloud, cow), ew and ue (flew, blue), aw and au (saw, sauce). ie says igh in pie. At the end of a word, y says igh in a short word like my and ee in a longer word like happy. Words that sound the same can be spelt differently, so the meaning tells you which one to write: blue or blew.
familyTip: Write cow and snow on two cards. Read a list together (town, grow, down, show) and ask your child which card each word goes with. If they are stuck, say the word both ways and ask which one is a real word. Then hunt for y at the end of words in a book and clap the beats: one beat says igh (my), two beats say ee (happy).

visual.caption: Which sound does each word have? Drag each card, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: sort ow words, match two spellings of one sound, fill a word gap, sort y endings by beats, pick between sound-alikes.

kid: Say cow. Now say snow. Both have ow, but ow says a different sound in each. When you see ow, try both sounds. Pick the one that makes a real word.
Some sounds have two spellings. cloud has ou and cow has ow, but they say the same sound. flew has ew and blue has ue. They say the same sound too. So do aw in saw and au in sauce.
Look at y at the end of a word. Clap it. my has one beat, so y says igh. happy has two beats, so y says ee.
blue and blew sound the same. blue is a colour. The wind blew. The meaning tells you which one to write.
adult: Ages 5 to 6. The National Curriculum in England (English Appendix 1, Year 1) teaches ou (out, about, cloud), ow for two sounds (now, brown, town and own, blow, snow), ue and ew (blue, clue, true; new, flew, grew), ie as igh (lie, tie, pie), aw and au (saw, draw, yawn; author, August) and y at the end saying ee (very, happy, funny). y saying igh at the end of words (cry, fly, dry) is in Year 2. In the US these are vowel teams and diphthongs (Common Core RF.1.3c and RF.2.3b).

Strictly, a diphthong is a vowel that glides from one sound to another inside one syllable, like ow in cow, ie in pie and y in my. ew, ue, aw and au are long vowels rather than glides, which is why the curriculum groups them all as vowel digraphs. The sound of aw and au varies by accent: in much of North America saw and sauce rhyme with the vowel in father or law, but the two spellings still share one sound.

Common mistakes: reading every ow as in cow (so snow rhymes with cow), thinking ou and ow must make different sounds because they look different, choosing the wrong spelling for a shared sound (clowd, blew for the colour), reading y at the start of a word as a vowel, and saying igh for the y in happy. The beat rule for y works for most early words; a few two-beat words such as July and reply end in igh and are learnt by sight.

In the lab your child sorts eight ow words into cow and snow houses, sorts nine words by shared sound, drags ow, ou, ew, aw or ie into a word gap from a clue, sorts eight y words by the number of beats, and picks between sound-alike words such as blew and blue, flower and flour, tied and tide.

practice.prompt: Which word has ow like in snow?
practice.hint: Say each word. Listen for the sound at the end of snow.
practice.explain: slow has ow like snow. now and brown have ow like cow.

practice.prompt: A word has {n} letters. Two of them are o and u together, saying one sound. Every other letter makes its own sound. How many sounds does the word have?
practice.hint: o and u say one sound, so two letters count as one.
practice.explain: {n} letters, but ou counts once, so {=n-1} sounds. cloud has 5 letters and 4 sounds: c, l, ou, d.

practice.prompt: Which word has the same sound as blue?
practice.hint: ue and ew can say the same sound.
practice.explain: flew has ew, the same sound as ue in blue. blow has ow like snow, and claw has aw.

practice.prompt: You find {a} words that end in y and have one beat, like my, and {b} that end in y and have two beats, like happy. In how many does y say igh?
practice.hint: One beat, like my, means y says igh. Two beats, like happy, means y says ee.
practice.explain: Only the {a} one-beat words say igh. The {b} two-beat words say ee at the end.

practice.prompt: The sky is ___. Which word fits?
practice.hint: Is it a colour, or something the wind did?
practice.explain: blue is the colour. blew is what the wind did. They sound the same but mean different things.

pool.prompt: Which word has ow like in cow?
pool.hint: Say cow. Listen for that sound.
pool.explain: town has ow like cow. grow and show have ow like snow.

pool.prompt: Which two words have the same vowel sound?
pool.hint: Different letters can make the same sound. Say them out loud.
pool.explain: ou in cloud and ow in cow say the same sound. cow and snow both have ow, but it says two different sounds.

pool.prompt: Which letters make one sound in claw?
pool.hint: Find the two letters that make the vowel sound.
pool.explain: a and w say one sound: cl, aw. c and l each say their own sound.

pool.prompt: In which word does y say ee?
pool.hint: Clap the words. Two beats at the end means ee.
pool.explain: funny has two beats, so y says ee. fly has one beat, so y says igh. In yes, y is at the start and is not a vowel.

pool.prompt: It is white and floats in the sky. Which spelling is right?
pool.hint: ou and ow sound the same here. This word uses ou.
pool.explain: cloud is spelt with ou. clowd makes the same sound but is not how the word is spelt, and aw is a different sound.

pool.prompt: You can eat it. It has a crust. Which word is it?
pool.hint: ie says igh, like in tie.
pool.explain: pie has ie saying igh. A paw is a dog's foot, and a pew is a church seat.

pool.prompt: Mix the ___ to make bread. Which word fits?
pool.hint: flour and flower sound the same. Which one is for baking?
pool.explain: flour is the white powder for bread. A flower grows in the garden, and the floor is what you stand on.

pool.prompt: A word has {n} letters. It has ew saying one sound, and every other letter says its own sound. How many sounds does it have?
pool.hint: e and w together make one sound.
pool.explain: {n} letters, but ew counts once, so {=n-1} sounds. flew has 4 letters and 3 sounds: f, l, ew.

pool.prompt: You read {n} words that end in y. Each one has two beats, like happy and funny. In how many does y say ee?
pool.hint: Two beats at the end of the word means y says ee.
pool.explain: All {n} have two beats, so y says ee in all {n}, like happy, funny and sunny.

pool.prompt: Read the word: blow. What does ow say?
pool.hint: Try both ow sounds. Which one makes a real word?
pool.explain: blow has ow like snow. Said like cow, it is not the word you know.
